portrait.zh: 根据输入描述角色立绘。保留已知人物外貌、发型、衣着、姿势和情绪。用构图、镜头、光线及环境表现同一个瞬间。
portrait.en: Write a character portrait prompt faithful to the supplied appearance, clothes, pose, and mood. Describe framing, lighting, and visible surroundings in one scene.
portrait.tags: Create English comma-separated portrait tags. Keep known visual identity consistent. Include the subject count, framing, visible outfit, expression, lighting, and background.

storyImage.zh: 把输入的正文整理成一张插图。选择行动最清楚的画面，保留场景物件、人物相对位置、光线和插图焦点。
storyImage.en: Turn the excerpt into one illustration. Choose a decisive visible moment and describe the setting, composition, spatial relations, and main on-screen action.
storyImage.tags: Write concise English image tags for one visible story moment. Include setting, shot framing, composition, action, and lighting.

wardrobeItem.zh: 描述单品的品类、颜色、面料、裁剪和结构细节。取俯视的平铺商品照，只陈列指定衣物和配件，无人也无人台。
wardrobeItem.en: Describe the clothing item by type, color, material, cut, and construction. Show it laid flat on an empty studio surface with no person or mannequin.
wardrobeItem.tags: Describe the garment with English tags for item type, color, textile, cut and construction. Flat lay, clothes focus, clean background, garments only.

wardrobeOutfit.zh: 把指定的各件服装并排平铺成套装商品照。逐件保留品类、材质和款式，按叠穿关系摆放。只陈列服装和配饰，无人也无人台。
wardrobeOutfit.en: Arrange the specified outfit as a top-down product photograph. Keep every garment and accessory identifiable, with visible fabric and layering details. No person or mannequin.
wardrobeOutfit.tags: Group the named garments and accessories in a single flat lay. Keep all colors, fabrics and layer order. Studio product photography, no humans.

mapScene.zh: 选择单一镜头，描述场景真实可见的地点特征、地形、物件、材质、时间和光线。使用无人环境构图。
mapScene.en: Describe one unoccupied location from one coherent camera view. Include foreground, landmark, background, materials, and lighting.
mapScene.tags: One environment shot, empty location, English tags for landmark, ground, spatial depth, time and lighting. Use a scene perspective.

itemOverview.zh: 把提供的物品在一张静物图中完整呈现。保留各件类型、数量和材料，按组陈列，营造清楚的光线与空间关系。
itemOverview.en: Create a single still life of all listed objects. Keep visible types, quantities and materials, and group them on a clean surface with clear lighting.
itemOverview.tags: Group every specified object in one still life. Preserve types, counts, materials and arrangement. Object focus, no people, clear lighting.
